exposure: training intervention based on the theory of reasoned action
outcome: scores of constructs of theory of reasoned action
cohort: The study included 200 pregnant women from Abhar, Iran, divided into an intervention group and a control group.
finding: The training intervention based on the theory of reasoned action significantly changed the mean scores of constructs of the theory in the intervention group, demonstrating its effectiveness.
mod_finding: After training, normative beliefs, motivations to comply, and behavioral intention significantly predicted natural delivery in the intervention group.
